{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction and print it
response_fraction = treatment_df['responded'].mean()
print(response_fraction)"}
